tara: Heads-up — quarterly access-review found 84 admin principals with missing owners or stale activity. Proposing a 'safe first' triage flow to reduce noisy alerts.

zach: +1. Need to avoid KMS cross-account false positives. Can we join key_owner_account and token_issue_ts?

tara: yes. starting query: SELECT principal, role, is_admin, owner, last_active_days, key_owner_account, last_token_issue_days FROM access_inventory WHERE is_admin=true AND (owner IS NULL OR last_active_days>180) ORDER BY last_active_days DESC LIMIT 200;

auditbot: ran against staging; sample hit: svc-telemetry (is_admin:true, owner:null, last_active_days:410, key_owner_account:"ext-mon-01"); svc-batch (is_admin:true, owner:null, last_active_days:95, last_token_issue_days:7)

min: Rule idea: treat principals with key_owner_account != NULL as crossacct -> low risk unless kms_usage_metric>0. Also add tag:long-job to exempt.

tara: Prioritization proposal: P0=admin && owner null && kms_bound -> manual review 24h; P1=admin && owner null && !kms_bound -> owner outreach 72h; P2=admin && owner present but >180d -> owner confirmation 14d; P3=nonadmin ownerless -> weekly digest.

zach: Safety: never auto-remove KMS bindings; require two approvers for admin removals; evidence blob (query, policy blobs, approver notes) saved to audit GCS with 180d retention; include a repro script in blob.

min: I'll export key_owner_account and last_token_issue to the nightly feed and add used_in_pipeline boolean.

auditbot: scheduled job access-safety-canary will run on staging Wed 04:00 UTC and post CSV to #eng-security-results.

tara: Action items: min -> export fields (due Mon); zach -> risk scoring + canary notifier (due Tue); tara -> draft runbook and appeal path (due Tue EOD). React with :thumbsup: if ok.
